profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at PNC
profile.summary:
Seeking to utilize software development and programming skills in designing and creating innovative applications to align to company’s goals, improve efficiencies and drive revenue. Thrive in a teaming environment partnering with co-workers in developing new solutions and brainstorming on new ideas. 

•	Comprehensive knowledge of MySQL and Oracle SQL databases, queries, and procedures
•	Unit testing
•	Enterprise Data Quality (EDQ)
•	Extensive experience programming with Java and Python
•	Exposure to webpage creation and development using HTML/CSS and JavaScript
•	Understanding of Agile Development 
•	Knowledgeable with Git, Lucidchart, and UNIX shell
